**A tidier Mac window.** The window buttons sit in the top-left corner like
other Mac apps, with the sidebar below them, and folder pickers open in your
home folder.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `cloak-v0.3.4-windows-x64.zip` | [WinFsp](https://winfsp.dev) (`winget install WinFsp.WinFsp`) |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `cloak-v0.3.4-macos-arm64.dmg` | [macFUSE](https://macfuse.github.io) |

**Windows:** unzip and run `Cloak\Cloak.exe`. Keep the folder together: the
engine is in `Cloak\bin`, and your drive list and settings are kept in
`Cloak\cloak-data`.

**macOS:** open the disk image and drag **Cloak** onto **Applications**. The
app isn't notarized, so before opening it the first time, clear the download
quarantine: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cloak.app` (or
right-click Cloak → Open, then Open again). macFUSE's kernel extension must be
allowed; on Apple Silicon that means its one-time Reduced Security setup.

## Changed

- **macOS:** the close, minimise and zoom buttons are in the window's
  top-left corner. The sidebar's menu button and items start below them, and
  the app name sits to their right. Before, the buttons sat beside the menu
  button, on top of the app name.
- **Folder pickers** (new drive, add an existing drive) open in your home
  folder instead of the top of the disk. On macOS they also become usable
  sooner.

## Known limitations

- Auto-lock runs on sleep, not when the screen locks.
- The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run
  (More info → Run anyway).
- The middle of every file stays plaintext on disk by design.
